summary.text: Bradley Watt is the One Nation candidate for Rowville at the 2026 Victorian election. According to the ABC's candidate notes, he once represented his state and Australia in badminton and has held senior business management and product development jobs with global sporting brands. In 2013 he was the Palmer United Party's candidate for the federal division of Aston.

occupation.text: Business management and product development (sports brands)

sources.title: Rowville: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Candidates of the 2013 Australian federal election, Wikipedia

summary.text: David Massey is the Greens candidate for Rowville at the 2026 Victorian election. On his party page he describes himself as a local father and grandfather who has represented workers through trade unions and done volunteer work. Neither the party nor the ABC gives his occupation.

priorities.text: More frequent and reliable buses and safer transport in Rowville
Better health care, including properly funded mental health services

sources.title: Rowville: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Dave Massey, Candidate for Rowville, Australian Greens

priorities.text: A return to Christian values in public life

summary.text: Fiona Dobrzynski is the Family First candidate for Rowville at the 2026 Victorian state election, on the VEC's list of nominations. According to the party, she was born in Sydney, moved to Melbourne as a child, worked for almost 15 years as a library officer and now teaches in secondary schools. She holds an arts degree in English and French and a graduate diploma in education.

sources.title: Candidates for Rowville District, Victorian Electoral Commission
Rowville, 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Fiona Dobrzynski, Candidate for Rowville, Family First Party Australia

summary.text: Lars Hiemstra is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Rowville at the 2026 Victorian election. He moved to Australia as a migrant and has raised his family in Melbourne's south-east, working first in manual jobs and now in transactional banking. He belongs to the Finance Sector Union and says he has campaigned against racism and for climate action.

priorities.text: A large public housing build, a rent freeze and action on empty investment homes
A state-owned bank offering home loans at fixed rates that can fall but not rise
Housing should be a human right, not a speculative asset.
Strong, affordable public services kept in public hands

sources.title: Rowville: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News

summary.text: Max Williams is the Liberal candidate for Rowville at the 2026 Victorian election, where the sitting Liberal MP Kim Wells is retiring. He has a social science degree and has mostly worked in communications, including at the Institute of Public Affairs. Earlier he worked as an electorate officer, and as a researcher for Matthew Guy during Guy's time as opposition leader.

prior_roles.role: Researcher, office of the Leader of the Opposition (Matthew Guy)

priorities.text: Safer roads and less traffic congestion
Making it easier to buy a home

sources.title: Rowville: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Max Williams, Liberal for Rowville, Liberal Victoria

summary.text: Muhammad Shahbaz is Labor's candidate for Rowville at the 2026 Victorian election, where Liberal MP Kim Wells is retiring. A doctor, he works as a general practitioner and in a hospital emergency department, and his party page describes him as a father living in Wantirna South. He stood for Labor in Rowville in 2018 and was on Labor's upper-house ticket in 2022.

occupation.text: General practitioner and emergency department doctor

priorities.text: Health care, drawing on his work as a bulk-billing GP
Labor's pledges of more nurses, keeping work from home and a 20 per cent cut to car registration
Services such as good schools and health care for families in the eastern suburbs

sources.title: Rowville: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Dr Muhammad Shahbaz, Labor candidate for Rowville, Victorian Labor
Candidates of the 2018 Victorian state election, Wikipedia
Results of the 2022 Victorian state election (Legislative Council), Wikipedia

summary.text: Scott Robson is the Libertarian candidate for Rowville at the 2026 Victorian election. He is a geologist who consults to the mining industry internationally, and his party says he has more than 35 years of experience in Australia and overseas. His qualifications include a Bachelor of Science and an MBA, and in 2022 he was an independent candidate in the federal division of Melbourne.

priorities.text: Individual freedom and personal responsibility, under a principle of doing no harm
Government that protects individual rights and delivers essential services well

sources.title: Rowville: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Candidates of the 2022 Australian federal election, Wikipedia
